name: The Three Treasures Zen Center of Oneonta
reason: Too thin: its own site (www.threetreasureszencenter.org, seven Squarespace pages; robots.txt puts Claude agents in the * group, so allowed) offers weekly sittings in rented church rooms in Oneonta and Binghamton plus online mornings, all on one schedule page, with no retreats, courses, resources or own videos (about 1-2 items) and no premises of its own. Email michaelotego14@gmail.com was published.
